# MFH Construction

> Fences & remodeling based in Nolanville, Texas. Malo builds fences and screened patios and remodels baths, floors and whole homes. Reviewers call him quick, knowledgeable and a true jack of all trades.

- Phone: (254) 393-5498
- Based in: Nolanville, TX
- Service area: Nolanville, Killeen, Harker Heights, Belton, Temple, Copperas Cove
- Google rating: 5.0 from 18 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/mfh-construction/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/mfh-construction/book.html

## Services
- Fences & gates: Cedar and pine privacy fences, board-on-board runs and Z-brace gates, plus storm repairs.
- Bathroom remodels & tile: Bathrooms redone with tiled tub surrounds, new vanities and design suggestions.
- Flooring & interior paint: Wood-look plank floors through living areas and halls, and fresh interior paint.
- Patios & screen rooms: Screened patio enclosures, covered patios and paver patio pads.
- Cabinetry, doors & custom builds: Custom cabinets and built-in shelving, door installs, and builds like a backyard greenhouse.
- Commercial build-outs: Shop and office interiors with new flooring, slatwall and built-in shelving.

## About
MFH Construction is an owner-run company based in Nolanville. Customers deal directly with Malo, who takes a rough idea, suggests options and builds it, whether that is a fence, a bathroom or a whole house. Reviews describe a full home remodel with paint, tile, custom cabinetry, doors and fencing, a 12 by 7 by 7 greenhouse, bathroom upgrades and fence repairs after the May 22, 2024 tornado. Photos show screened patio rooms, paver patios and a commercial interior build-out with new floors and shelving.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you repair storm-damaged fences?
  A: Yes. MFH repaired fences after the May 22, 2024 tornado, and also builds new cedar and pine privacy fences with gates.
- Q: Can you help me decide what my bathroom should look like?
  A: Yes. One customer didn't know what she wanted, and Malo suggested options that left her bathroom looking stunning.
- Q: Do you take on full home remodels?
  A: Yes. One customer had MFH handle paint, tile, custom cabinetry, doors and fencing in a single remodel.
- Q: Do you do commercial work?
  A: Yes. MFH has finished commercial interiors with new flooring, slatwall and built-in shelving.
- Q: Which areas do you cover?
  A: Nolanville, Killeen, Harker Heights, Belton, Temple and Copperas Cove.
